gameDesignDoc.title: Dock Pulse: Swarm Break
gameDesignDoc.elevatorPitch: A expansive arcade game set between dock and canyon, where the player uses pulse and spike actions to outmaneuver swarm forces and drive a expand-to-upgrade progression arc.
gameDesignDoc.worldConcept: The world blends dock, canyon, pulse into a hostile traversal space patrolled by swarm, commander, pulse, pushing the player through compact but expressive runs.
coreLoop: Scout routes through dock spaces and identify swarm pressure points.
Use pulse and spike interactions to survive, reposition, and secure objectives.
Convert each run into expand gains that unlock stronger options and open the next challenge band.
contentPillars: Traversal built around pulse, spike, haul.
Threat reads driven by swarm, commander, pulse.
Forward momentum shaped by expand, upgrade, pulse.

aggregatedDocument.smootherSummary: Merge dock, canyon spaces with pulse, spike verbs, then pressure the run with swarm, commander threats and resolve it through expand, upgrade growth.

designDoc.playerFantasy: Feel like a fast improviser navigating dock hazards while turning commander pressure into opportunities.
designDoc.sessionStructure: Short repeatable runs, escalating from expand setup to upgrade payoffs, with each success adding a new decision layer.
designDoc.visualDirection: Lean on dock, canyon, and swarm motifs for strong silhouettes, readable threat zones, and punchy arcade contrast.
